_comment: National survey reference per ISO country code: horizontal grids (role primary, zone or legacy), height systems and the geoid model. Every EPSG code is resolved through pyproj by tests/modules/survey_core/test_survey_reference.py and must carry the token its datum name starts with. Geoid grids are never shipped; proj_grid names the PROJ-data file an administrator installs. angle_unit and linear_unit are preselects (practice), not law. Packs may add entries, never replace these.
